connector.name: MCP by Massed-Compute
connector.registryDescription: Massed Compute MCP - GPU inventory, VM lifecycle, billing, SSH keys, and setup recipes.
connector.summary: Hosted at vm.massedcompute.com over streamable HTTP, also runs locally from the npm package massed-compute-mcp. Needs a bearer token header, and it reaches all 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the massed-compute account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A bearer token is sent in a request header. Store it outside the config file wherever your client supports it.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Your Massed Compute API key as a Bearer token (include the 'Bearer ' prefix). Generate one at https://vm.massedcompute.com/settings/api — use a read-only key for analysis-only assistants so destructive tool calls (launch, restart, terminate, SSH-key deletion) are rejected at call time.

env.name: MASSED_COMPUTE_API_KEY
env.description: Your Massed Compute API key (Bearer token). Generate at https://vm.massedcompute.com/settings/api. Optional — `massed-compute-mcp init` provides an interactive first-run flow that prompts for the key, validates it, and stores it locally with 0600 permissions.
